functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Runs in its own fibro-osseous tunnel through the flexor retinaculum, separate from the carpal tunnel proper.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: A single rectangular nerve-dense region of about 5.95 cm2, entered by the median nerve branch in the proximal third. Highest spindle abundance in its middle third, at 38.53% of muscle length. One of only four anterior forearm muscles whose nerve-dense region actually sits near mid-belly, which is where the conventional mid-belly injection assumption would put it.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Zhou J, Jia F, Chen P, Zhou G, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Localisation of the centre of the highest region of muscle spindle abundance of anterior forearm muscles', J Anat 244(5):803-814 (2023), doi:10.1111/joa.14000 -- 24 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and spiral CT localisation

injection_target_points.label: main
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: SURFACE NOT ESTABLISHED. The source places all but one of its eleven projection points on the anterior forearm and one on the posterior forearm, but the label identifying the exception was lost in full-text extraction, so `depth_measured_from` is omitted here rather than guessed. The three percentages are unaffected; confirm the surface against the paper's CT localisation figure before planning a needle path from the depth figure.
injection_target_points.source: Zhou J, Jia F, Chen P, Zhou G, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Localisation of the centre of the highest region of muscle spindle abundance of anterior forearm muscles', J Anat 244(5):803-814 (2023), doi:10.1111/joa.14000 -- 24 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and spiral CT localisation

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the volar forearm, 4-5 cm distal to the elbow crease, on the radial side, medial to the radial cortex.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial flexor layer, medial to pronator teres.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Triangular in cross-section, against the oval pronator teres laterally.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Targeted where spasticity limits wrist extension and blocks a functional hand position.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part I -- Distal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(3):107 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17030107

trigger_points.location_description: Muscle belly in the proximal third of the forearm, about two to four fingerbreadths distal to the medial epicondyle along the line toward the radial wrist crease.
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Radial side of the volar wrist crease, spilling into the radial mid-palm; pain on loaded wrist flexion, wringing and screwdriver use.
trigger_points.activation_perpetuating_factors: Forceful repetitive wrist flexion with pronation (screwdriver, racquet forehand and serve, wrist curls), sustained gripping, direct trauma; part of the "pseudo golfer's elbow" flexor-pronator complex with pronator teres, palmaris longus, flexor carpi ulnaris and the finger flexors.
trigger_points.notes: Non-myofascial differential per the source document: FCR tendinopathy, scaphotrapeziotrapezoid (STT) and basal-joint arthritis, scaphoid pathology, radial artery pathology, palmar cutaneous branch neuroma, carpal tunnel syndrome. (Pain referred INTO FCR territory from other muscles -- pronator teres, palmaris longus, opponens pollicis, pectoralis major, subscapularis, scalenes -- is the document's reverse-lookup table, not FCR's own trigger point, and is omitted here.)
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons (1999) Trigger Point Manual, 2nd ed., Vol. 1, ch. 38; Donnelly et al. (2019) 3rd ed., ch. 38, pp. 366-377 -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded wrist muscle reference.
